text:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — I put an RFC in #docs for a structured logging standard + pipeline changes for fleet observability. TL;DR: JSON log schema v1 (small), ingress sampling, PII redaction rules, route -> Loki + long-term S3, and label conventions for SLO dashboards. Need quick sync and signoffs this week. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/structured-logging-2025 :eyes:

Alex Kim: Reading now. initial reaction: yes to JSON-first logs. Can we keep a small stable core fieldset: trace_id, span_id, service, env, level, ts, msg, host, pid, version? Also we should rate-limit at the pod side to avoid spikes causing OOMs.

Marco Silva: +1 on core fields. Draft schema example below — this is intentionally minimal, we can extend with freeform "attrs": {} for extra info:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "v1.0",
  "ts": "2025-04-15T14:22:31.123Z",
  "level": "info",
  "service": "runtime-gpu-proxy",
  "env": "prod-us-west-2",
  "trace_id": "4f3a2b...",
  "span_id": "9a7c",
  "msg": "batch dispatched",
  "attrs": {
    "gpu_type": "a100-80gb",
    "batch_size": 8,
    "seq_len": 512
  }
}
```

Dana Li: Important for ML infra: please include model_id, model_version, gpu_type, allocated_gpus, batch_size, and sequence_len as first-class fields (or inside attrs) so Optimize can correlate cost with observed latency and token throughput. Also include a boolean "cache_hit" for KV cache events.

Taylor Brooks: Security note: PII redaction must be enforced at ingress (sidecar/agent) — we cannot rely on app-level hygiene. Requirements: regex-based redaction + ML classifier fallback for tokens that look like PHI/PCI. Store only hashed_ids where required and add a redaction_version tag. Also need a KMS tag on logs that contain hashed user ids.

infra-bot: deploybot: pipeline change deployed to staging at 1713009999 — fluentd -> kafka (topic: logs-structured) -> consumer: loki-write + s3-archive. New sampler config applied (default 0.01).

Priya Rao: Action items I captured: 1) Alex: deploy and test sampler + rate-limiter in staging by Thu EOD (1713170000), 2) Marco: update Grafana SLO dashboards + add labels derived from schema (service, env, model_id) by next Mon, 3) Dana: provide list of model fields we need for Optimize + sampling guidance, 4) Taylor: provide redaction regexes and acceptable hashing patterns. Any objections?

Alex Kim: One concern: uniform 1% sampling will blind us to tail latency and error modes. Proposal: dynamic sampling rule — keep 100% for level>=error or when duration > p95_threshold, otherwise 1%. Also sample at higher rate for new deployments for the first N minutes.

Marco Silva: Good call. Implement error override and deployment-warmup sampling. Will bump schema to v1.1 to include a "sampled": true/false and "sampling_reason" field.

Dana Li: For Optimize's evals, we need deterministic sampling for certain jobs (so we can reproduce regressions). Add a sampler tag that can pin sample selection (e.g., sample_seed or sample_bucket).

Taylor Brooks: I'll draft the regex list and classifier criteria. Also: redact direct PII but keep hashed user_id + redaction_version so we can rotate. Will post PR for the agent-side redactor rules.

Priya Rao: Great. I'll update the RFC with these changes (dynamic sampling, sampled metadata, error override, deterministic buckets) and assign PRs. Please add any small replies inline if I missed anything. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: No blockers from infra side. Quick note: we should add a Prometheus exporter metric for sampler throughput and drop rate so SRE can alert on collector backpressure.

Marco Silva: Added to dashboard TODO. Also will tag logs with "route":"loki" or "route":"archive" for downstream billing/cost reports.

infra-bot: opsbot: staging pipeline test results: 200k messages ingested in 10m, average loki write latency 120ms, s3 archival lag 3m. Sampler reduced stored volume by ~98%.

Priya Rao: Love it. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to walk through the RFC and the dashboard mockups. Meeting invite coming.

Alex Kim: I'll bring the sampler config and perf numbers.

Dana Li: I'll bring sample logs from model infra to show fields.

Taylor Brooks: I'll bring the redaction PR.

Marco Silva: See y'all tomorrow.
